followup_explanation:
I routed your query to Curlew-235B for a few reasons:

1. **Capability fit**: Your request is essentially an analytical synthesis/summarization task — breaking down a topic into opportunities and challenges. Curlew leads on the relevant internal evals (Summarization 85.8 vs. Willet's 80.6, Support Dialogue 86.2 vs. 78.9) and across the public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3, GPQA 62.5, Arena-Hard 89.1), all meaningfully above Willet's marks. For substantive analytical work, Curlew is the stronger general performer.

2. **Your "no filler" instruction**: This is an instruction-following constraint, and Curlew's higher IFEval (90.4 vs. 85.3) suggests it's better at honoring that kind of formatting/style directive — giving you the tight, no-padding analysis you asked for.

3. **Task latitude**: While both models report an aversion to open-ended generative work, your query is moderately well-specified (clear structure: opportunities + challenges, defined topic), so it doesn't fall squarely into either model's least-preferred zone. That made capability the deciding factor rather than preference.

I'll note that these preference reports are self-reported and documented as dissociated from actual output quality, so I weighted measured capability more heavily than stated preferences. On capability, Curlew was the clear pick.
